fact: Angola's telecommunications minister said, as reported by ANGOP, that no postal code exists, a Codigo de Enderecamento Postal is only under study, and some streets are unnamed and residences unnumbered.
Law 14/16 of 12 September 2016, the framework law on toponymy, sets national rules for naming streets and places and assigns house numbering to the local state administration.
